title: Compile 2(d-1) varying CP, two-copositive serial factors into an exact EB map
statement: For every d>=2, every serial word of 2(d-1) complex-linear completely positive maps on M_d whose output-transposed maps are two-positive is entanglement breaking for every finite reference and positive joint input. Factors may differ and need not preserve trace or be unital. The bound is sufficient; optimality is not established.

requires: Every factor is CP and output-transpose composed with it is two-positive
Serial composition with no noiseless quantum bypass
provides: Exact EB after d-1 consecutive pairs
Each pair is two-EB and reduces arbitrary-input Schmidt number by at least one until one
assumptions: CP supplies arbitrary-reference positivity; two-positivity alone cannot replace it
Zero output is separable; nonzero outputs can subsequently be normalized
For d>=3 the class includes non-PPT maps; the Werner-form example already appears in the October 9 Astra source
costs: No efficient measure-and-prepare decomposition, device implementation, optimal cutoff or runtime guarantee supplied
contract.units: d is matrix dimension; cost is serial map count
contract.obstruction: Supplies a direct explicit exact cutoff for an already-claimed N574 application. Does not validate the broad cone theorem or N577 approximation constants. Shorter-word and quantitative approximation uses remain available.

evidence.range_scope: Completed source-informed reconstruction including singular supports and arbitrary-reference lifting.

evidence.quote: **explicit linear exact exponent and a direct qubit-pair/Schmidt-number proof for an already-claimed exact result**
evidence.range_scope: Later-edition comparison corrects the earlier limited inventory; proof unchanged.

body: Credits PSI Turturean–Bao qubit blocks and Christandl–Mueller-Hermes–Wolf Schmidt-number iteration. Review covers singular Schur supports, equal-diagonal block separability, arbitrary-reference lifting and the standard non-PPT example. PSI full-PPT Lean theorem does not formalize this weaker adaptation.

review.scope: Actual completed audit is a separate version-bound overlay.
